import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
specs=[
 ('Bridge','chat-6ac45836-87a0-83ed-bea4-0ad0f99c8982','4e67b543-7d83-42df-9389-0707659dd36a'),
 ('Native','agent-pc-control','5dc21cfa-6bad-4df8-a493-99d0ece5a248'),
 ('QA','chat-6ac45fb0-9074-83eb-99eb-397265b228e7','49bac301-f296-4501-a478-05a9b7de5456')
]
out=[]
for label,chat,aid in specs:
 d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments?chatId='+chat,timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8'))
 row=next((x for x in d.get('assignments',[]) if x.get('id')==aid),{})
 keep=['state','lastPreflightReason','lastDiagnostic','dispatchTargetId','dispatchCount','dispatchSubmitAttempted','currentHead','ciRunId','ciConclusion','updatedAt','awaitingEvidenceAt','completedAt']
 out.append({'label':label,**{k:row.get(k) for k in keep}})
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))

note: Read-only status for active Bridge Native QA assignments.
